items.title_en: AI is less regulated than milk, says Microsoft president
items.title_zh: 微软总裁表示人工智能比牛奶受到的监管更少
items.desc_en: Brad Smith calls for global rules on AI, and says the UK is in the "best position" to lead the charge.
items.desc_zh: 布拉德·史密斯（Brad Smith）呼吁制定人工智能全球规则，并表示英国处于引领这一潮流的“最佳位置”。

items.title_en: King warns malicious online actors are evolving tactics
items.title_zh: 金警告恶意网络行为者正在不断演变策略
items.desc_en: The King spoke of "threats to our international order" in a letter marking the 10th anniversary of the National Cyber Security Centre.
items.desc_zh: 国王在纪念国家网络安全中心成立十周年的信中谈到了“对我们国际秩序的威胁”。

items.title_en: Rogue Anthropic AI agent gave police fake tip in unsolved murder case
items.title_zh: Rogue Anthropic AI 特工在未侦破的谋杀案中向警方提供虚假线索
items.desc_en: Philadelphia police said the tip was "flagged as spam", but criticised the tech company for taking more than two months to detect and report the breach.
items.desc_zh: 费城警方表示，该提示被“标记为垃圾邮件”，但批评该科技公司花了两个多月的时间才发现并报告违规行为。

items.title_en: How drones are hunting fires hidden beneath the Cairngorms
items.title_zh: 无人机如何搜寻隐藏在凯恩戈姆山脉下方的火灾
items.desc_en: Dramatic flames from the huge Cairngorms wildfire in July have disappeared - but hot spots can continue to burn beneath the earth.
items.desc_zh: 七月份凯恩戈姆山野火的剧烈火焰已经消失，但热点可能会继续在地下燃烧。

items.title_en: Prize-winning image which sparked backlash was AI-generated, Nikon rules
items.title_zh: 尼康裁定引发强烈反对的获奖图像是人工智能生成的
items.desc_en: The camera-maker says it is now re-evaluating the rules and procedures of its Small World in Motion contest.
items.desc_zh: 这家相机制造商表示，目前正在重新评估“运动中的小世界”大赛的规则和程序。
